knife throwing.name: knife throwing
knife throwing.description: Throwing blades at a target, on the board in front of a crowd or at somebody who's earned it, and the roll says how close it lands, a poor one sticks in the wood a hand's width off, a good one pins a sleeve to the boards, and a great one goes exactly where you were looking before anyone saw your arm move.

sleight of hand.name: sleight of hand
sleight of hand.description: Card tricks, palming coins, lifting a purse or slipping something into a pocket that wasn't there before, a poor roll gets you caught with your hand in someone's coat, a good one gets it done with nobody the wiser, and a great one has them thanking you for the show while you walk off with their watch.

animal handling.name: animal handling
animal handling.description: Calming, training and reading animals, the show's horses, a guard dog at a farm gate or Bramble on a bad night, a poor roll and the animal smells your nerves before you know you've got any, a good one and it settles and does what it's asked, and a great one and it follows you round like you raised it.
